hold_text: Follow-up to held Tier-2 PR #22624 (GH-CAPACITY-INFRA-RUNNER); the manager merges this lane's PRs.
why: Fix two install defects found on the first live runs: (1) the job-completed credential-wipe hook never ran -- the runner refuses a hook path without .sh/.ps1/.js ('not a valid path to a script', vm-diag-snapshot run 41636162263), so ~/.ssh keys written by jobs persist; renamed to jta-runner-job-cleanup.sh and each runner .env repointed idempotently; (2) drop the invalid '--disableupdate=false' config.sh argument. The hook still deletes the workspace: a checkout measured 6.6 GB vs 17 GB free on the trainer. Takes effect when infra-runner-install is re-run.
